item.title: The Kasumi Coast: Sea Cliffs and Caves of the San'in Geopark — Guide
item.description: The Kasumi coast, on the Sea of Japan shore of northern Hyogo, is the finest coastal scenery in the prefecture and part of the San’in Kaigan UNESCO Global Geopark. Millions of years of volcanic rock and relentless northern swell have carved the shoreline into columned cliffs, arches, sea caves and pine-topped islets standing in strikingly clear green water. Small sightseeing boats thread among them from the fishing harbour, clifftop paths link viewpoints along the shore, and the same port that draws visitors in summer lands the snow crab that fills the town’s inns in winter.
